facts.fact: The ToR says the Government of Malawi, through the Ministry of Information and Digitalization and the Department of e-Government, established the National Data Centre in Lilongwe, which will have 13 empty racks available for co-location; the document is dated January 2025 and gives no other date.

systems.tiers: Tier-III (stated, not certified; expected fully operational March 2025)

note: Opening is stated as expected March 2025 and hosting of ministries' data as future, so no service, tier3 or state fact is recorded.
